description: This is a unit test class for the PIMLeftMenuService, specifically testing the accessibility and menu item retrieval functionalities within the Pim module of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the PIMLeftMenuService functions related to menu accessibility and caching in the Pim module.

methods.name: getAllMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to mock retrieval of all menu items, optionally with tax menu enabled.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsAllMenusAccessible
methods.description: Test case verifying that all menus are accessible when permissions are granted.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsOnlyDependentsAccessible
methods.description: Test case verifying menu access when only dependents data group permission is granted.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuOneEmployee
methods.description: Verifies that cached menu data for a single employee can be cleared correctly.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuOneEmployeeNotCached
methods.description: Verifies cache behavior when employee data is not yet cached.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuAll
methods.description: Verifies that all cached menu data can be cleared for all employees.

methods.name: testIsPimAccessibleTrue
methods.description: Checks that Pim is accessible when permissions are all granted.

methods.name: testIsPimAccessibleFalse
methods.description: Checks that Pim is not accessible when permissions are denied.
